parse.title: Hubris (Night)
parse.text:
Overview

Hubris (Night) is a MythicalMythical unit. He is only obtainable via Summon.

Evolving

Hubris (Night) can evolve into Hubris (Day) with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Hubris (Night)
x2 Demonic Chalice
x2 Demonic Horn
x1 Fairy Petals
Result
Hubris (Day)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 500 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
